notices.text: Messages already received keep trailing spaces that make them look double spaced at 80 columns on a phone, most of all in OTHERNETS, until they are rendered again. Run node src/tools/maintenance.js --regen-html with the worker running (add --area SHORTCODE to do one area first), even if you ran it after updating to 0.9.11a. It changes nothing but how stored messages are displayed.
